text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — noticed the 'shadow session completed' flag in Orbit isn't syncing with our LMS completions. Several interviewers marked complete in LearnPort but Orbit still shows them as pending.
Ty: That's a problem for mandatory calibration requirements. Which cohort?
Aisha: Mostly new grads and contractors onboarded last week. Example: Sam P shows completed in LMS (learnport:id=usr-889) but Orbit profile says first_time_panel=true.
Ben: Could be the LMS webhook consumer failed to ack. I'll check the ingestion logs around last Wed 14:00-16:00.
Rita: We have panels tomorrow with those folks. If Orbit thinks they're first-time, we'll force shadow pairing and double-book a mentor. Not ideal.
Aisha: For immediate workaround: please ask leads to confirm shadow status in debrief and if needed, manually add note "shadow-confirmed" in candidate timeline. I'll also temporarily relax enforcement for panels scheduled in next 48h.
Ty: Relaxing enforcement might let uncalibrated interviewers slip through. Can we do a quick repair script to backfill flags for any LMS completions in the last 14 days?
Ben: I can run a dry-run. The LMS provides completion events with `event_type=course.complete` and `meta.course_id=interviewer-shadow-v1`. I'll map by email and set orbit.flag=shadow_done if match. Dry-run first.
Rita: Also check that the LMS exported timezone is UTC; we've had mapping issues where midnight PST completions looked like previous-day events and missed the window.
Aisha: Good call. Also noticed a related UX gap: Orbit's interviewer profile page doesn't surface LMS completion ID, so it's hard for hiring ops to verify. Can we add a quick column in the admin CSV export?
Ben: I'll add `lms_completion_id` to the export. For now, I'll run the backfill dry-run and post counts to OPS-5522.
ops-bot: OPS-5522 created: "LMS -> Orbit shadow completion sync failures". Priority: P2. Owner: Ben.
Ty: While Ben runs the backfill, I'll patch the webhook consumer to retry unacked events and add an alert for >10% sync failure rate in a day.
Rita: We should also update onboarding: remove the hard gate that blocks panel assignment until orbit.flag=false for the next 48h cutover. Otherwise schedulers will keep reassigning mentors.
Aisha: Agreed. I'll coordinate message to schedulers and hiring managers with a template: instruct them how to confirm shadow status manually and what to do if unsure.
Ben: Dry-run results: 34 completions found, 29 perfect email match, 5 ambiguous (aliases). OPS-5522 notes include CSV with candidates for manual review.
Ty: For aliases, we can attempt fuzzy match on name + cohort date, but I'll leave manual review for hires. We'll also add an inbox workflow to resolve alias mapping.
Rita: Training ops suggestion: run a 10-min mandatory refresher for anyone who completed shadow in LMS in last 30 days to re-assert key scoring behaviors. Make it async video + 2-question quiz.
hiring-bot: New micro-training "Shadow refresher (5m)" published to #hiring-resources. RSVP optional. :bookmark_tabs:
Aisha: Once backfill is confirmed, please update this thread and I'll finalize the scheduler note. Also flag any panels where we need urgent mentor pairing.
Ben: Backfill applied to staging, will push to prod after a 1hr validation window. Expect full fix in ~3hrs including webhook retry logic.
ops-bot: NOTE: schedule created for audit-run to check past 30 days sync. Owner: Ben.
Ty: After prod fix, let's add metrics: sync latency, percent matched, and a small UI badge on interviewer profile showing "LMS synced" with timestamp. That should reduce manual checks.
Rita: Agreed. Thanks everyone — will update hiring managers and run the mentor pairing list.
